verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official MCP server as part of its Agentic Toolbox, intended for connecting Qodo-managed skills to a remote or custom agent, workflow, or application (qodo-docs-33, qodo-probe-3). It exposes review capabilities such as retrieving and resolving findings (qodo-docs-6) and brings Qodo's code understanding and standards into existing coding agents, with admin access controls (qodo-docs-4, qodo-docs-37). Missing for 10: connection setup, auth and transport details, a full tool inventory, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
